campaign_name: PR-EG-R6-R2 — Entity-Role Grounding and Semantic Relevance
purpose: Implement and qualify bounded semantic correspondence while preserving host authority.
executive_summary: **C — SEMANTIC GROUNDING BELOW ACCEPTANCE.** Implemented bounded entity-role and proposition correspondence under the existing R6 gate. 384 tests passed; 5 inherited failures; 0 new failures. Fresh production /api/chat recorded 122 turns across 9 conversations. Matching improved in selected cases, but correction and follow-up failures and clarification loops prevent qualification. No positive qualification is claimed.

validation: 37 new controlled cases, 120 target fresh turns, frozen holdouts.
generated_artifacts: Transcripts, model traces, JUnit, matched comparisons, score audit and metrics.

testing.model_runtime_boundary: Configured provider; actual model IDs in usage. Separate local transcript scoring is not human qualification.

campaign_specific: Corrections and follow-ups fail; generic clarification loops.
Argument paraphrase and source interpretation remain limited.
Observed latency and token targets passed; semantic quality remains below acceptance.
pre_existing: Five failures in expanded baseline selection; includes two previously known failures.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Review below-acceptance result and proposed architecture revision.
missing_concepts: Durable delivered-question identities and robust semantic correction binding.
does_not_prove: A/B qualification, universal semantic correctness, external independent holdout authorship, or full arbitrary-state nonmutation.
recommended_next_step: External review of PR-EG-R6-R2. Keep default gate off. Stop; do not begin PR-EH.
